clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, an empty red waterskin is bound for a well untouched by blight. Brine gives it to shaman initiates for their elemental trials.

Brine gives shaman initiates this plain red skin for the Call of Water trials. They carry it across the sea to Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Forsaken occupy the town, but its central well still draws fresh spring water. The filled skin brings a sample to Brine, who blends the water into a vial of purest water for the initiate’s trial.
